theorem withTopEquiv_symm_lt {x y : ℕ∞} : withTopEquiv.symm x < withTopEquiv.symm y ↔ x < y := by

--src: Mathlib.Data.ENat.Lattice
lemma sSup_mem_of_nonempty_of_lt_top [Nonempty s] (hs' : sSup s < ⊤) : sSup s ∈ s :=
  Nonempty.csSup_mem .of_subtype (finite_of_sSup_lt_top hs')

--src: Mathlib.Topology.Instances.ENat
theorem tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} {f : α → ℕ∞} :
    Tendsto f l (�� ⊤) ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᶠ a in l, n < f a := by
  simp_rw [nhds_top_order, lt_top_iff_ne_top, tendsto_iInf, tendsto_principal]
  exact Option.ball_ne_none

--src: Mathlib.Order.WithBot
theorem lt_iff_exists_coe : ∀ {a b : WithBot α}, a < b ↔ ∃ p : α, b = p ∧ a < p
  | a, some b => by simp [coe_eq_coe]
  | a, ⊥ => iff_of_false (WithBot.not_lt_bot _) <| by simp

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Defs
protected lemma exists_congr' (h : ∀ b, p (e.symm b) ↔ q b) : (∃ a, p a) ↔ ∃ b, q b :=
  e.exists_congr_left.trans <| by simp [h]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Sigma.Order
theorem lt_def [∀ i, LT (α i)] {a b : Σi, α i} : a < b ↔ ∃ h : a.1 = b.1, h.rec a.2 < b.2 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, a, b, h⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, h⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, a⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨j, b⟩ := b
    rintro ⟨rfl : i = j, h⟩
    exact lt.fiber _ _ _ h

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Find
@[simp] lemma find_lt_iff (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) (n : ℕ) : Nat.find h < n ↔ ∃ m < n, p m :=
  ⟨fun h2 ↦ ⟨Nat.find h, h2, Nat.find_spec h⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hmn, hm⟩ ↦ Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.find_min' h hm) hmn⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.CompleteLattice
@[simp] lemma iInf_lt_top : ⨅ i, s i < ⊤ ↔ ∃ i, s i < ⊤ := by simp [lt_top_iff_ne_top]

--src: Mathlib.Order.WithBot
theorem map_eq_some_iff {f : α → β} {y : β} {v : WithTop α} :
    WithTop.map f v = .some y ↔ ∃ x, v = .some x ∧ f x = y := Option.map_eq_some'

--src: Mathlib.Order.WithBot
theorem strictAnti_iff {f : WithTop α → β} :
    StrictAnti f ↔ StrictAnti (fun a ↦ f a : α → β) ∧ ∀ x : α, f ⊤ < f x :=
  strictMono_iff (β := βᵒᵈ)
